summary: This class models the Add Device page in the HPX Rebranding flow for Windows automation. It follows the Page Object Model (POM) pattern with clear separation between verification methods (verify_*) and action methods (click_*, input_*, get_*). The class uses driver-based element interactions with configurable timeouts and exception handling. Locators are referenced as string identifiers passed to driver methods rather than being stored as class attributes. The class provides comprehensive coverage for adding devices, including serial number search, product number entry, HP Smart integration, and Microsoft Store interactions.
